architecture_claims.statement: The retained pack contains official license and README bytes; external kernel implementations are not silently attributed to this source.
The official README describes Kimi Delta Attention and a hybrid organization of KDA and global MLA layers.

mechanism_candidates.falsification_test: Compare compressed-only, attention-only, and hybrid variants under equal memory and quality targets.

mechanism_candidates.semantic_definition: Combine a compressed recurrent or delta state path with periodic global attention.
mechanism_candidates.source_fact_boundary: The official source describes KDA/global-MLA organization; independent MetaEngine transfer is untested.
